name: Qorqbot
summary: Proactive agent for complex work that runs on your computer with your own model subscriptions. Personal use is free forever; commercial licensing is stated on the official pricing page.
description: Proactive agent for complex work that runs on your computer with your own model subscriptions. Personal use is free forever; commercial licensing is stated on the official pricing page.

pricing.details: Personal 0 € forever — every feature, no trial, the full app, free for non-commercial use and for charities, schools, public research and government bodies. Commercial license regular 9 €/month per person, billed 109 € annually — company, client and paid work, unlimited agents, all your computers. Official promo: commercial use is free until 1 January 2027, then needs the commercial license at the regular price above (work accounts are emailed first; nothing is charged automatically). This free commercial window is a promo, not the regular commercial price. Team license and hosted servers marked “coming soon”.
